name: mutant-census
description: The workspace's quality layer, executed: the burial record's historical defects COMPILED into nine mutation operators (each re-enacting a real error class, provenance on the row), replayed against the shared kernel family and its standard compositions, and KILLED one by one by a ten-property battery that holds for every seeded input (dual-path arithmetic, negative controls, statistical kills labeled DATA-grade). Mutation testing (DEM78, JIA11) and property-based testing (CLA00) are established fields; the claim here is the COUPLING — and, since 0.3.0, the CLOSED LOOP: the burial record is imported LIVE on every run and EVERY error it carries is enrolled to the guard that kills it now (117 on live mutants via a declared-class tie, 222 on build gates anchored file+needle to disk, 153 booked unenforceable with printed reasons) — an error without an enforcement anchor cannot be buried. Since 0.10.0 the BOOKED tier is itself audited data (R-board): every booked reason is refuted or held against the machines that exist now, born-audited at burial time; since 0.11.0 every UPGRADED row carries needle-level firing evidence in the cited gate's own tree (R4, the deep check) and the census's own stated counts are law (E7) — a self-description that drifts from its own arithmetic fails the build; since 0.13.0 the per-error equivalence question is measured on ALL FOUR classes exhaustively (J-board: the ENTIRE 117-row mutation-killed population — nine provenance collapses, every prototype one; twelve error-level kills; TWO PROVEN equivalent specimens of two different species, representation-blind and input-coverage-blind; ninety-four unbuildable). The kernel family's byte-identity across every repo is censused live (unregistered drift fails the build), the repos' engineering hygiene is machine-swept with zero tolerated unguarded entries, and one command (`npm run total`) judges the whole workspace's tests AND typechecks. Since 0.17.0 the identifier-grade citation face is needle-held too (the b55#3 family first pinned to disk: the corrected VDL23 DOI); since 0.18.0 the repro-no-op family is closed at four run-all needles (batch 76 enrolled it systemic: postselect/qram/retro/switch, with a full-workspace audit priced) and the author-table citation face with it; since 0.19.0 the fourth wave's fourteen conviction sites are registered the moment the rows first sat on them (batch 77: readout-wall/survivor-census/ent-clearing/binding-price, two latent v0.1.0 defects among them closed at their own regression needles). Survivors would be declared SURVIVED and booked as blind spots — a silent survivor is a hidden one.
